subject: pathology
title: Hepatitis, cirrhosis and liver failure

steps.tx: **Hepatitis** is hepatocyte injury with inflammation from viruses, alcohol, drugs, autoimmunity or ischaemia, ranging from silent enzyme rises to fulminant failure. Necrosis patterns matter: spotty lobular necrosis in acute viral disease, bridging necrosis linking vascular structures in severe attacks and interface hepatitis at limiting plates in chronic active disease. Recovery, chronicity or fulminant collapse depends on cause and host immunity.
steps.say: Hepatitis injures hepatocytes from viruses, alcohol, drugs or autoimmunity. Bridging necrosis means severe disease. Interface hepatitis marks chronic activity. Outcome depends on cause and immunity.

vis.alt: Histological image showing three patterns of liver necrosis: spotty lobular, bridging between vascular structures, and interface hepatitis at the limiting plate.
vis.caption: Hepatitis necrosis patterns: spotty, bridging, and interface

steps.tx: Viral serology decodes stage better than any single test, and examiners rotate these patterns. **HBsAg** marks hepatitis B infection, anti HBs marks immunity, IgM anti HBc marks acute infection and HBeAg marks high replication. Hepatitis C antibody needs RNA confirmation, while hepatitis A and E are faecal oral and usually acute except E in pregnancy and immunosuppression.
steps.say: Hepatitis B surface antigen means infection; surface antibody means immunity. IgM core antibody means acute disease. Hepatitis C needs RNA proof. A and E spread faecal orally.

rows: Does not distinguish acute from chronic alone
With anti HBc means past natural infection
Window period may show this alone
Antibody alone may be cleared infection

steps.tx: **Cirrhosis** is diffuse fibrosis with regenerative nodules destroying architecture from any chronic liver injury, irreversible once established though its cause may be treatable. Portal hypertension follows from increased intrahepatic resistance plus splanchnic vasodilation, producing ascites, splenorenal shunts with varices and splenomegaly. Synthetic failure lowers albumin and clotting factors while encephalopathy reflects gut derived neurotoxins bypassing detoxification.
steps.say: Cirrhosis scars the whole liver into nodules. Portal pressure rises causing ascites, varices and big spleen. Failed synthesis and detox cause clotting failure and encephalopathy.

left.title: Compensated cirrhosis
points: No ascites, variceal bleed, jaundice or encephalopathy yet
May be clinically silent with firm liver or splenomegaly
Surveillance for varices and liver cancer

right.title: Decompensated cirrhosis
points: Ascites, bleeding, jaundice or encephalopathy present
Infections and kidney failure precipitate decline

steps.tx: **Alcohol related hepatitis** adds steatosis, ballooned hepatocytes with Mallory Denk bodies and neutrophil rich inflammation, while metabolic dysfunction steatohepatitis mirrors it in obesity and diabetes without alcohol. Mallory bodies also appear in Wilson disease and drug injury, so they suggest rather than prove alcohol. Abstinence and metabolic control remain the disease modifying treatments.
steps.say: Alcohol hepatitis shows fat, ballooned cells, Mallory bodies and neutrophils. Metabolic steatohepatitis looks similar in obesity and diabetes. Mallory bodies suggest but do not prove alcohol.

steps.tx: Fulminant **acute liver failure** combines coagulopathy with encephalopathy in a liver without prior cirrhosis, classically from paracetamol overdose or viral hepatitis depending on region. Cerebral oedema kills early, so head positioning, infection surveillance and transplant referral cannot wait. Chronic failure instead declares itself through decompensation events and hepatorenal physiology.
steps.say: Acute liver failure means clotting failure plus encephalopathy without prior cirrhosis. Brain swelling kills early. Refer for transplant immediately while treating the cause.
